newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Loss sees Burns Philp shares slide.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Loss sees Burns Philp shares slide.

text.p: Shares in food group Burns Philp and Co slid 10 cents or nearly five percent to A$1.95 in morning trading after the group reported a net loss of A$61.8 million for the full year to June 30 and failed to declare a dividend.
Included in the results were abnormal losses of A$A$140.2 million related to rationalisation costs and writedowns of the group's North American assets.
"A woeful result and passing their dividend hasn't helped but a poor result was expected for some time," said Jim Tredenick, senior dealer at Nevitts Ltd.
Managing director Ian Clack said the company had seen some improvement in the first two months of the new financial year and was looking at divesting other non-core assets.
By 12.30 p.m. (0230 GMT), Burns Philp shares were 10 cents lower at A$1.95 on turnover of 108,968 shares.
